==================
acl with flags on the declaration
==================

acl foo +log -pedantic +table +fold {
    "192.168.0.0"/16;
    ! "10.0.0.1";
    "localhost";
}

---

(source_file
  (toplev_declaration
    (acl_declaration
      (ident)
      (acl_flag)
      (acl_flag)
      (acl_flag)
      (acl_flag)
      (acl_entry
        (string)
        (literal
          (number)))
      (acl_entry
        (string))
      (acl_entry
        (string)))))

==================
acl with parenthesized entries
==================

acl foo {
    ("192.168.0.0"/16);
    ! ("10.0.0.1");
    (! "::1");
}

---

(source_file
  (toplev_declaration
    (acl_declaration
      (ident)
      (acl_entry
        (string)
        (literal
          (number)))
      (acl_entry
        (string))
      (acl_entry
        (string)))))
